datasets.title: Flooding in the Philippines on July 23, 2025
datasets.description: This dataset shows the actual extent of flooding in the Philippines caused by typhoons or tropical cyclones as of July 23, 2025, as observed through available satellite imagery. The dataset can be used to track the progression of floods over time, identify areas at risk, and assess the impact of these natural disasters on infrastructure, agriculture, and local populations.. [Source: This metadata record was automatically extracted from the Humanitarian Data Exchange (HDX); Original dataset: https://data.humdata.org/dataset/philippines-flood-20250723]
datasets.details: This dataset has not been validated using ground-truth data.

lineage.description: Satellite imagery from Sentinel-1 and RCM sensors acquired on July 23, 2025 was processed to delineate flood extent polygons caused by typhoon-induced precipitation. The resulting shapefiles and map products document the observed spatial distribution of flooding across the Philippines at two time points.
